name: Kiran Avinash Sode
title: AI Engineer | Forward Deployed Engineer
bioParagraphs: I'm an AI Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) with 5 years shipping GenAI and full-stack systems from POC to production. I embed with product, sales and engineering to turn ambiguous needs into working prototypes — then harden the LLM workflows and the Kubernetes and serverless AWS platform underneath them for real production.

connect.text: Based in Hyderabad, India — open to relocation (Netherlands, Japan) and global remote. Always happy to talk AI products, agent platforms, or FDE roles.
